name: What types of sliding door locks can be repaired?

mainEntity.name: What types of sliding door locks can be repaired?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most common types of sliding door locks can be repaired, including mortise locks, hook locks, and surface-mounted latches. Repairability depends on the specific issue and the availability of replacement parts. For example, issues with the locking cylinder, latch mechanism, or handle assembly can often be addressed. We work with various brands and styles of sliding door locks found in homes throughout areas like San Mateo and Redwood City. A thorough inspection helps determine the feasibility and scope of the repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most mortise, hook, and surface-mounted sliding door locks can be repaired, depending on the damage and part availability. An inspection determines repair feasibility.
